(ja)༄༅/ /dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag la rtsod spong bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa s+t+wi sidhaṃ/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rta

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag la rtsod spong bzhugs so// oṃ swa s+t+wi sidhaṃ/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam par bzhag pa la rtsod pa spang ba theg chen chos kyi srol chen rnam dbye zhes bya ba/ dus kyi byed pos gang brtsams pa// dus med na ni mi 'byung phyir// dus gsum dgra dang zung 'jug pa'i// dus 'khor sna tshogs yum khyod la// phyag 'tshal nas ni dus 'khor lo'i// 'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag pa// mngon pa'i chos dang ma mthun pas// log par bshad zer de spang bya// gangs can 'di na phyis byon pa'i// mang thos rnam dpyod 'khyog por ni// 'jug la som nyi ma mchis pa'i// grags pa gsal ldan dag na re// sa chen dum bu bcu gnyis par// kla klo'i chos 'jug grags pa yis// de 'joms de yi bstan pa ni// lo stong brgyad brgyar gnas zhes grags// sgra mi snyan du kla klo'i chos// 'jug na mi dge bcu yod 'gyur// drag po'i bstan pa der gnas na// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod rung 'gyur// de lta na ni rgya che ba// mngon pa'i gzhung dang ma mthun zhing*// khungs btsun 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs ni// kun dang 'gal bar gyur zhes smra// 'di la thog mar lan gdab pa// dngos dang rnam gzhag rgyas bshad do// dang po dngos kyi ma nges dang*// 'dod thog lan gyis bzlog pa'i phyir// dam bca' ba la sun 'byin pa// ltar snang tshar bcad gnas zhes bya// 'dir bshad dum bu bcu gnyis pa// mngon par bshad pa'i sgra mi snyan// yin na de ltar thal mod kyi// de ma yin phyir der mi thal// mngon par bshad pa'i sgra mi snyan// 'dir bshad dum bu bcu gnyis par// khyed kyis khas len byed nus na// sun 'byin snga ma 'dod thog go /gnyis pa rnam gzhag rgyas bshad pa// don tshan gsum dang rtsod spang dang*// 'phros pa'i don dang rnam lnga yis// theg chen gzhung lugs gsal por 'chad// don tshan dang po thun mong gi

/gzhung du mi 'thad gang bshad pa// thun mong min pa'i lung gis ni// sun 'byin nus pa bstan pa'i gzhung*// yin gyi de las ldog gyur pa// dman pa'i lung gis theg chen gzhung*// sun 'byin byed po'i ltag chod pa// yid rton byed po su zhig 'byung*// don tshan gnyis pa 'jig rten na// lhan skyes gzung 'dzin gnyis snang blo// gang shar de la der snang dang*// mthun par sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs// 'o na snang tshul 'gal gyur pa'i// 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag kun// 'gal la mi 'khrul khas len nam// zhe na sems can so so yi// 'khrul snang gcig tu gzhal mi nus// don tshan gsum pa sems can nas// sangs rgyas bar gyi blo snang kun// rang rang sems su thag chod na// 'gal ltar snang yang mi mthun med// rtsod spang byang gling dbus ma ni// sgra mi snyan gling ma yin na// lho gling dbus ma 'dzam bu gling*// min par nges phyir khyod gzhung gi /dpal ldan 'bras spungs sogs bshad pa// 'dzam bu gling na med 'gyur zhing*// 'dzam bu gling gi rnam gzhag kun// lho gling dbus mar med 'gyur zhes// zer na mngon par gang bshad pa'i// gling rnams mtha' dag 'dir bshad pa// de de min zhing 'dir bshad pa// de yang de min par 'dod do// rang rang lung nas gang bshad pa'i// rnam gzhag de dag rang rang gi /gling na yod do rang rang gi /mkha' la ji ltar 'char bshad bzhin// khyed kyang dpal ldan 'dus pa yi// 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag che// rdul phran bsags pa'i 'jig rten khams// 'dod na theg chen lugs las nyams// de mi 'dod na mngon pa yi// gzhung dang 'gal ba ma yin nam// mngon pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i lung*// sun dbyung mi nus na der 'dod// yang ni rgol bas 'dir rtsad pa// rigs su mi mthun 'gro ba la// phyi rol dngos gcig du mar snang*// rigs mthun 'gro la dngos po gcig

/du mar snang ba med ces zer// 'di 'dra mang du thos pa dang*// dpyod ldan smra min tshig gcig la// lung dang rigs pa dang 'gal ba'i// nyes chen brgya dag 'bab phyir ro// phyi don rnam med rjen char du// 'char 'dod nyan thos mu stegs kyi// gzhung na don gcig du mar ni// snang ba'i tshad ma khas mi len// rnam bcas mdo sde pa'i gzhung na// du mar snang ba dang rang gi /gzung ba'i rnam pa nyid min gyi// don gcig dngos su snang mi 'dod// de lta mod kyi rang rang la// rnam pa gtod byed rdul phran nas// 'jug pa'i yul dang gzung ba'i yul// nyid phyir de la de tshad mar// 'dod kyi chu yi dngos gcig la// 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i// 'gro drug mngon sum tshad ma ni// rigs pa'i gzhung nas bshad pa med// bye brag theg pa cher zhugs nas// phyi rol don gcig gzung yul du// byed pa'i tshad ma khas len na// chos kyi bdag med pa las nyams// de phyir don gcig du mar ni// snang ba yod dang med pa yi// rgol dang lan gyis ci zhig bya// 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i// yang dag ma yin kun rtog la// don dang bdag tu gang snang ba// de la de der 'dod pa ni// 'jig rten lugs kyi tha snyad bden// tha snyad bden pa'i ngor yod pa// kun kyang tshad mas grub bo zhes// zer nas stong pa nyid smra ba// chad pa'i mthar lhung ma yin nam// 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten khams// 'jal byed bag chags brtan byung gi /tshad ma rnyed pa dka' zhe na// mngon par bshad la'ang ci mi mtshungs// chos las de yod gsungs pa'i phyir// zhe na gzhan la'ang ci mi mtshungs// bsam pa'i dbang gis mi 'gal na// tshangs pa'i yul chen ci phyir 'gog /zer mod gsal bar gang snang ba// yod par nged kyis khas ma blangs// gcig shos kyis ni de yod par// khas blangs mu stegs byed pa'i gzhung*// stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug la sogs// mthu ldan rnams kyi spyod yul te// tha snyad bden pa'i ngo na med// zer ba 'di yang phyi rol don// khas len ches pa'i rnam thar te// sgyu ma mkhan po'i mig 'phrul yang*// mthu ldan rnams kyi spyod yul du// smras na skyon ci yod pa soms// phyi rol don gyi 'khrul snang dang*// sgyu ma dri za'i grong khyer sogs// 'dra mtshungs sbyor ba theg chen gyi// chos lugs kun nas gsungs pa yin// rigs mthun 'gro la dngos po gcig

/du mar snang ba mi 'thad ces// zer la brgal zhing brtag bya ba// phyi don khas len tshe na yang*// mi yi 'gro ba rnam gsum po'i// dgra gnyen bar ma'i gzugs gcig la// yid 'ong mi 'ong sogs gsum dang*// bum gzugs gcig la nye ring nas// blta ba'i shes la gsal mi gsal// sna tshogs 'byung bar gang bshad dang*// rdo shing sogs kyi khang bzang la// rnal 'byor pas mthong gzhal med khang*// ma dag 'jig rten khams chen po// rdzogs sangs rgyas la dag par snang*// ma dag pa nyid der snang na// gnas dang yo byad dag par ni// byin brlabs byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// de la'ang ma dag der snang na// byin brlabs byas pa don med 'gyur// mdor na rigs mthun 'gro ba la// dngos gcig du mar snang med ces// zer ba chos kyi dbyings las ni// ma gtogs chos gzhan med pa'i gtam// go ba med pa'i rnam 'gyur te// theg pa chen po'i chos las nyams// ci phyir zhe na chos kyi dbyings// gcig po sangs rgyas sems can dang*// dngos dang dngos po med pa dang*// 'chad pa po dang nyan po dang*// ngan song ba dang mtho ris dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched kyis// rnam par snang yin de las gzhan// de de'i rnam par snang ba med// chos dbyings de yang rang rang gi /shes rgyud nyid yin de las gzhan// kun la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i// nam mkha' lta bur khas mi len// de nas 'phros pa'i don bshad pa// 'dir 'byung gzhal bya gnas gsum po'i// rnam gzhag 'chad pa'i skabs dag tu// theg pa che chung lugs gzhan dang*// 'gal ba brjod rnams 'dir bsam bya// 'og ma'i lung gis gong ma'i gzhung*// sun 'byin nus na grub mtha' dang*// theg pa gsum po'i go rim kun// gting nas 'khrugs pa ma yin nam// mngon pa'i lung dang 'dul ba'i gzhung*// tshad mar bzung nas grub mtha' bzhi// byung tshul dang ni rig byed bzhi// byung tshul 'dir bshad mi 'thad ces// zer dang kun la ma grags pas// bka' bsdu'i rim pa mi 'thad sogs// gang la sgrub byed 'god pa'i ngor// dpyad pa gsum gyis ma dag pa'i// lung 'dren pa ni gegs byed tsam// yin gyi sgrub byed tshad ma ni// min par chos kyi grags pas gsungs// khyad par 'og ma'i lung gis ni// de 'gal gong ma'i lung don la// gegs byed tsam du'ang mi rung ste// gong mas de la gnod byed phyir// nges pa'i don dang drang don gyi// dus 'khor dbye ba ma phyed pas// bzhi tshan gnyis po de nyid kyi// zhal las gsungs pa 'gog mi nus// nges pa'i don gyi dus 'khor la// thog ma yod pa ma yin zhing*// drang don gzugs sku'i dus 'khor gyi// zhal las ma byung chos 'ga' med// dus 'dir sngags kyi rnam gzhag kun// 'og ma'i grub mthar 'dren byed cing*// grub mtha' de yi de nyid las// nyams pa'i phyogs tsam brjod par bya// rdul phran bsags pa'i ri rab sogs// mthong ba'i rnam shes tshad mar 'dod// 'di ni bye smra mu stegs kyi// gzhung yin de las gong na med// sngags pas dam pa'i bdag gi ni// ngos bzung med par kun rdzob pa'i// nga nyid lhag pa'i lha'o zhes// bdag tu rmongs pa mu stegs gzhung*// dngos gcig rigs drug 'gro ba la// snang tshul kun gyi rgyu yin zhes// bzung don khas len mdo sde pa'i// gzhung yin theg chen chos la med// dbang yid mngon sum tshad ma yis// phyi don dngos su rtogs shes pa// mdo sde smra ba'i gzhung las kyang*// nyams par chos kyi grags pas bshad// sngags su ye shes las gzhan pa'i// tshad ma 'thad par mi bzhed phyir// rnam shes tshad ma sems tsam pa'i// gzhung las gong du 'phags pa med// gzugs sgra la sogs don lnga po// rig pa'i mngon sum tshad ma ni// khas blangs phyir na sems tsam pa'i// gzhung yang de bzhin 'chad ma shes// gang la gzugs sogs su snang ba// de de gzugs sogs dngos yin zhes// zer ba bye brag smra gzhung du// rnam par 'khyams pa ma yin nam// gsang sngags bla med sems tsam pa'i// lam du 'gro ba'i dogs mthong nas// kun gzhi dang ni rang rigs pa'i// ye shes 'gog la 'bad byed mod// sngags kyi nges don mthar thug pa// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*// bde stong zung 'jug gting nas nyams// rdul phran bsags las ma byung ba'i// phyi don rags pa khas len pa// sngags dang thal 'gyur lugs yin zhes// zer ba grub mtha' kun las nyams// zla grags gzhung srong byed po yi// ngal bas chos 'khor gsum par ni// gang bshad drang don yin zer ba// rdo rje theg pa'i lung las nyams// thal 'gyur gzhung las ma bshad pa'i// nges don gsang sngags la med ces// zer bas sngags kyi tshogs gnyis po// thams cad kun rdzob bden par bsgrags// de lta na ni de dang de// ye shes las grub smos ci dgos// 'phral dang phugs kyi ma rig pas// bslad pa'i 'khrul snang kho nar thal// sngags su bden pa gnyis po yi// rnam dbye 'phros don 'dir bshad pa// ma rig gis bslad rnam shes la// gang snang thams cad 'dir kun rdzob// yin mod tha snyad byed dus su'ang*// rnam shes yul gyi bden pa gnyis// 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus bslad pa dang*// ma bslad pa la ngos bzung nas// 'jig rten pa dang mu stegs kyi// bden pa gnyis po bsam par bya// ye shes yul du gang shar ba// de dag de kun 'dir don dam// yin no bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*// rdzogs pa zhes bya'i dbye bas gnyis// bskyed pa ye shes las sgrub phyir// rlom tshod don dam nyid song mod// rtog pa'i yul du gang shar ba'i// yul ni kun rdzob bden pa dang*// gsal bya don dam pa'i bden par// 'chad nus phyir dang ma rig pa// kho nas bslad pa min phyir yang*// kun rdzob kho nar 'chad mi nus// skyed rim lam du 'gro tshul yang*// rtog pa dang ni rnam shes kyi// cha nas ma yin spang bya'i phyir// gsal gyur ye shes cha nas so// gang yang theg pa che 'dir ni// rnam shes dang ni ye shes la// gang snang de shes nyid yin gyi// de las gzhan chos srid ma yin// ye shes la snang ye shes nyid// yin phyir dam pa'i don dang ni// rnam shes la snang rnam shes nyid// yin phyir kun rdzob pa'i bden pa// rigs pas gtan la phebs pa yi// med par dgag pa'i stong pa nyid// spyi mtshan nyid phyir mngon sum gyi// yul du gsal bar snang ba med// rtog pa'i yul du gang shar ba// gzung cha gzhan sel nyid dang ni// 'dzin cha rtog las ma 'das phyir// shes bya kun rdzob pa'i bden pa// de lta na ni stong pa nyid// gtan la phebs pa'i rigs pa yang*// 'phral dang phugs kyi ma rig pas// bslad pa nyid du thal zhe na// chos gang gang la de der ni// zhen pa'i cha de ma rig pas// bslad yin de la 'phral dang ni// phugs kyi dbye bas gnyis 'chad de// lhan skyes rtog pas der zhen pa// phugs kyi ma rig pa nyid de// chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis// stong pa gshis kyi gnas tshul dang*// de shes pa ni lhan skyes kyi// rmongs pa'i 'gal zla nyid phyir ro// thos bsam rtog pas de der ni// 'khrul rgyu grub mthas kun brtags pa'i// yang dag rtog pa nyid yin phyir// log pa'i kun rdzob tu mi thal// yang dag kun rdzob yang dag pa'i// khang chen 'dzegs pa'i stegs yin phyir// bden zhen min pa'i mtshan 'dzin ci// spang byar 'dod pa min zhe na// byams pas spang gnyen rten can gyi// rtog pa gnyis su phye ba dang*// sman nyid dug tu song ba'i dpes// gsungs pa'ang stong par zhen pa'i blo// rtog kun 'khrul phyir tshad min na// byis blos spros pa'i mtha' kun dang*// bral bar 'jal byed rjes dpag las// gzhan pa gang zhig btsal zhe na// rjes su dpag pa gzhal bya la// tshad mar bshad pa gang na'ang med// 'jug pa'i yul la mi bslu ba// tsam gyis tshad mar bshad mod kyang*// 'jug pa'i yul ni rang mtshan phyir// sgra dang rtog pas de mi 'jal// lugs 'dir gzhan sel mi 'chad cing*// 'chad tshe'ang btags pa'i yod nyid phyir// tshad mas rtogs dang gzhal byar ni// khas len nus pa ma yin no// rtags la rten pa'i rjes dpag ni// sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i gzung rnam dang*// rang gi ngo bo 'dzin rnam las// ma gtogs gzhan gyi dbye ba med// 'dzin pa'i rnam pa rang rig pa'i// mngon sum nyid phyir rjes dpag min// gzung rnam tshad mar 'chad pa'i tshe// 'jug yul nyid la gzhal bya zhes// btags nas rang rig 'bras bur bshad// gzhan sel gzhal byar bshad pa med// rjes dpag tshad mar 'gro ba'i tshul// mngon sum las gzhan mi 'chad na// lkog gyur gtan la 'bebs byed kyi// rtags dang tshad ma ci zhe na// rigs pas sgro 'dogs bcad shul du// 'jal ba'i gzhal bya rang mtshan ni// yod min spyi mtshan tshad ma yi// 'jal tshul rigs pas brtags mi bzod// gzung rnam tshad mar bzhag pa'i tshe// spyi mtshan gzhal byar 'jog pa ni// rnam 'grel mdzad pas tshad 'bras kyi// gnas skabs gang du'ang bshad pa med// skabs 'dir ye shes las gzhan pa'i// gzhal bya'i gnas gsum yod min pa// de tshe sgrub po rang nyid kyi// shes la gang snang mngon gyur dang*// gzhan gyi rgyud dang sangs rgyas kyi// ye shes lkog gyur rnam gnyis so// rtags la brten pa'am ma brten kyang*// gzhan gyi sems rgyud snang ba ni// rang sems nyid kyi gzung rnam phyir// rang rig ye shes las ma 'das// rgyud gzhan grub pa ltar snang ba// glo bur dri ma dang bcas pa'i// ngor yin rdzogs sangs rgyas blo yi// ngor ni rdzogs sangs rgyas min med// sems can med par thal zhe na// 'o na snod kyi 'jig rten yang*// rang snang la med gzhan snang la// yod pas 'gal ba med ce na// 'o na bcud kyi sems can yang*// de ltar 'chad nus min pa ci// de ltar mgo mtshungs rnal ma'i lan// sngags kyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// thams cad stong nyid ye shes las// bsgrub pa yin no de yi tshe// sdug bsngal kun 'byung khas mi len// yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas pa'i// rnam pa thams cad dben pas na// sangs rgyas sems can ji snyed pa// bde ba chen por ro gcig spyon// ces dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag la rtsod pa spang pa'i tshul la 'phros nas theg pa gong 'og gi gzhung gi rnam par bzhag pa/

ma 'dres pa nyid du dbye ba'i gtam chen po rnam par nges pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di yongs su grub pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
